user.description: Choose whether to set up the global ThermoSmart controls (Summer & Vacation mode) or add a new heating zone.

add_system.title: Global Controls
add_system.description: Sets up the global Vacation, Force Summer and Auto-enable Summer switches. No thermostat required. They apply to all zones. Automatic summer detection uses the outdoor temperature below (own sensor first, weather entity as fallback); without either it never enables summer mode.

data_description.summer_on_threshold: Automatic summer mode turns on when the 72 h average outdoor temperature is at or above this value.
data_description.summer_off_threshold: Automatic summer mode turns off when the 72 h average is at or below this value. Must be lower than the start value; in between, the current state is kept.

control_options.title: Zone Control Strategy

data_description.zone_control_mode:
**Setpoint only:** ThermoSmart sends the plain target temperature and the TRV regulates its valve on its own.

**TPI setpoint modulation:** ThermoSmart calculates the heating demand and raises or lowers the setpoint sent to the TRV to open or close its valve.

**Direct valve control:** ThermoSmart writes the calculated valve opening (0–100 %) to the TRV's valve position entity and sends the plain target as setpoint.
data_description.control_interval: Minimum time between regular control cycles. Each cycle recalculates the heating demand and writes setpoints, valve positions and state settings to the TRVs. Events such as opening a window or a manual override can trigger an extra cycle sooner. Shorter intervals cause faster reactions but may also overload devices or congest networks, e.g. Zigbee. In practice, 2-3 minutes combined with reasonable thresholds for temperature changes, which must be cleared for new values to be sent to the TRV, should be fine.
data_description.ext_temp_threshold: The value from the external temperature sensor is sent to the TRV only after it has changed more than this threshold compared to the last update. Only has an effect when an external sensor is configured and for TRVs for which the external temperature input is enabled.
data_description.temp_tolerance: A new setpoint is sent to the TRV only if it differs from the TRV's current setpoint by at least this value. Larger values reduce radio traffic, smaller values make the TRV follow ThermoSmart more closely.
data_description.trv_setpoint_debounce: Wait this long after the last setpoint update from a TRV before applying it as the zone target. This lets you finish adjusting the dial; only the last reported value is used.
data_description.trv_setpoint_settling: After ThermoSmart writes to a TRV, ignore setpoint reports from that TRV for this long to avoid treating delayed echoes or intermediate device updates as manual changes.

device_settings.title: TRV Settings (TRV {index}/{total})

data.window_off: Turn off when window is open

data_description.feed_external_temp: Sends the room temperature to the TRV. Requires selecting the correct external temperature input entity below; nothing is sent without it.
data_description.valve_maintenance: Prevents valves from sticking during extended periods without heating. ThermoSmart occasionally moves the valves automatically while Summer Mode or Vacation Mode is active.
data_description.calibration_sync: Corrects the TRV's internal temperature sensor by writing the difference to the room temperature into the calibration entity below. Turn off for TRVs that use an external temperature source. Requires a calibration entity.
data_description.calibration_entity: Number entity that holds the TRV's local temperature calibration offset. Leave empty to disable calibration.
data_description.calibration_invert: Enable if the TRV applies the calibration offset with the opposite sign.
data_description.valve_entity: Number entity that controls the valve opening of this TRV. Only needed if direct valve control is enabled for this TRV, otherwise it is ignored and can be left empty. ThermoSmart writes 0–100 (%), or 0–1 for entities whose name contains "level".
data_description.window_off: Turn off the device (HVAC mode off) when a window is open. If you use this, you should make sure that your TRV still has frost protection enabled when turned off (some models do, but not all) to prevent freezing. If you disable this toggle, the TRV will be kept in heat mode but set to the window open target temperature defined on one of the next pages instead when a window is open.
data_description.accept_setpoint_changes: When enabled, a setpoint changed on this TRV is adopted as the zone target after the configured debounce. The same target is then applied to all TRVs; changes are also accepted while a window is open.

temperatures.title: Temperatures
temperatures.description: Zone **{zone}**: temperatures for the presets (Comfort, Eco, Night, Away, Vacation) and for open windows. A preset simply sets the zone's target temperature.

data.eco_temp: Eco temperature (energy saving, between night and comfort)

data_description.window_open_temp: Target temperature set on a TRV while a window is open, unless that TRV is configured to be turned off when a window is open (see the per-device settings). For thermostats that do not support very low setpoints, use a higher value such as 10 °C.

schedule_event.description: Choose the weekdays, local time and whether this event should pre-heat. You choose or edit its target next.

schedule_target_type.title: Schedule Event Target
schedule_target_type.description: Choose the target type. Current target: {current_target}

outdoor.title: Outdoor Data
outdoor.description: Zone **{zone}**: all fields are optional. Each own sensor is used first; for every value without a working sensor the weather entity's current value is used instead. The zone also works without any outdoor data.

data_description.weather_entity: Only the current conditions are used (no forecast). Leave empty if you only use own sensors.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Own sensors are more accurate than the weather entity and are preferred.

error.entity_not_found: Weather entity not found. Please select a valid entity or leave the field empty.
error.summer_thresholds_inverted: The end value must be lower than the start value.
error.required: At least one thermostat / TRV is required.
error.night_temp_too_high: Night temperature must be lower than comfort temperature.
error.away_temp_too_high: Away temperature must not be higher than night temperature.
error.schedule_conflict: This event overlaps an existing event on at least one weekday at the same time. Choose a different day or time.
error.schedule_invalid: The schedule event is invalid. Select at least one weekday and review its time and target.
